basic_profile.bio: An avid fan of music from The Wonder Years, I grew up in a small town where nuclear deterrence was a topic of interest due to a nearby military base. Now living in a bustling city, I work as a junior analyst in a tech firm, which allows me to explore my love for mecha and robotics in my free time. I usually browse Reddit during my lunch breaks and late at night. I'm single and enjoy attending local music gigs and science fiction conventions.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Political Science, I have a strong understanding of international relations and military history, particularly in nuclear weapons. My passion for mecha stems from childhood fandom and a deep interest in robotics, which I've pursued through online courses and community forums.
